text:
Dear Sir

A few years ago my husband had a brain tumor. It was malignant and he has been very sick ever since. Now his only real pleasure in life is smoking. That’s all he wants to do. He is unable to work, drive or even be by himself. I’m buying as many as 3 cartons of cigarettes a week and it’s used hard financially. We are hoping that maybe you could send us some coupons worth more than 300. You have no idea how much that would help us. Please consider this.

Yours truly
Rosa Coffey
